notes: Spiking deconvolution, seed 4101, stabilization 1e-6. Wall times include harness conversion and Metal process startup, shader compilation and file I/O. Relative difference is the largest per-output max absolute error divided by that reference output's max absolute value. Metal child RSS is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta can be zero after warmup or an earlier larger child; child_peak_rss_mb also reports the absolute high-water mark. MLX process RSS is the lifetime high-water mark. Memory units are decimal MB on macOS.
